_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the information architecture of The Playpen School site. build.py and shell.py read this file; nothing about which pages exist, how they are grouped, what the menu and footer show, or which phone numbers appear is written anywhere else. Page ids (P02...) are the ids in DS's full site plan (P03 'Welcome from the Principal' is not built: it needs the Principal's own words). 'slug' is always the URL path with a leading and a trailing slash. A page's source lives at build/pages/<slug-without-slashes>.html or build/pages/<slug>/index.html. Fields per page: id, slug, label (short name for menu, footer, breadcrumb), title (document title and default H1), template (T01..T12, see 'templates'), parent (breadcrumb parent slug or null), group (key of the primary-menu group or null), menu (true = listed under its group in the full-screen menu), footer (footer column key or null), description (SEO meta description, 60 to 170 characters, plain text with no HTML entities, factual), summary (one line for chapter cards and the human sitemap), optional: menu_label (a longer name for the full-screen menu only, e.g. the class range; label stays short for the breadcrumb, cards and eyebrow), footer_label (the name in the footer column), eyebrow, og_image (path under site/assets/), noindex, schema (school | faq | contact | about | collection | article), sitemap (false keeps it out of sitemap.xml and the search index), actions (false hides the sticky actions on that page).

redirects._readme: Old flat pages of the previous site. build.py writes a meta-refresh stub for each at site/<old>. 'to' is the default target; 'hashes' maps an old #anchor to a better target (the stub's inline script reads location.hash).

wordpress._readme: Paths of the old WordPress site (playpen.edu.bd) and the page that replaces each one. check.py reports any link to these paths that is not on the external_ok list ('use {{link:...}}'); vercel.json gets a 301 for each (build.py writes it).
